
list (ls):
  Return a bounded inventory of discoverable operations, ownership, and execution availability.
  usage: tadx capability list [flags]
  options:
    --config (--cfg) <path>  path to the non-secret TADX configuration file
    --domain (--dom) <domain>  filter by exact command domain
    --full (--ful, -f)  show expanded bounded details
    --json (--jsn)  render machine-readable JSON instead of TOON
    --limit (--lim, -l) <1..10000> (default: 20)  maximum capabilities to return, up to 10000
    --mutation (--mut)  filter by remote mutation status
    --owner (--own) <owner>  filter by exact owner
    --product (--prd) <product>  filter by product availability
    --resource (--res) <resource>  filter by exact resource

  --help (-h)  Show help only; never run the operation.
  Boolean flags accept =true or =false; a bare flag means true. Omitted options keep their documented default.

notes (capability (cap)):
  Use capability IDs to inspect ownership, availability, and bounded operation details.
